request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Icicle Antler Doe".

Creative brief
Name: Icicle Antler Doe
Collection: Frostveil Pack. Cold-climate animals adapted to blizzards, frozen lakes, icicles, and delayed shattering projectile patterns.
Core concept: A graceful ranged enemy that drops delayed icicles from marked positions.
Body and silhouette: Slender doe with long legs, a narrow head, and delicate branching ice antlers.
Signature features: Hanging icicle points, frost collar, and glowing hoof marks.
Palette and materials: Pale tan, snow white, icy blue, and muted silver.
Movement personality: Alert, graceful, and evasive.
Attack concept: Marks three small frost circles on the ground; icicles descend into them after a clearly readable delay.
Directional details: The right antler has one fewer branch than the left.
Avoid: Huge majestic boss deer, realistic antler complexity, invisible falling projectiles.
